The golden rule of microservices data management: each service owns its data and its schema; other services may not read or write that database directly.

CDC is reliable (it reflects committed transactions), decoupled (producers need no awareness of consumers), and non-intrusive — but it exposes the schema at the log level, so schema evolution must be managed.
